questions.held: S6 and S7 are ranked; S8 (props) is blocked; no joint-probability model exists.
questions.missing: A validated joint probability and the operator's void and push rules.
questions.discover: Obtain the operator's rules; validate joint probabilities on the holdout; or retire combinations from the leaderboard.

questions.q: Should backtest numbers ever appear on the leaderboard?
questions.held: They appear today. The brief forbids it.
questions.discover: Owner decides between a separate backtest page and a prospective-only leaderboard.

questions.q: Which strategy list is canonical: 7, 8, 11 or 18?
questions.held: Counts of 8, 7 and 18 in three builds (F04).
questions.missing: One register with IDs and commit hashes.
questions.discover: Freeze one register; retire the others with a pointer.

questions.q: How many past seasons of injury reports should be archived?
questions.missing: The owner's span, and verified archive URLs.
questions.discover: Check each week's league path (nfl.com/injuries/league/<year>/reg<week>) and record the ones that resolve.

questions.q: What authorised structured source gives Houston depth?
questions.held: The club page is an image; coverage gap recorded.
questions.missing: Authorisation from the club or the league.
questions.discover: Owner request to the club or league; do not transcribe the image by eye.

questions.q: Where are the official NFL game books?
questions.held: None captured. The path tried returned 404.
questions.missing: A URL that resolves for 2026 games.
questions.discover: Find the game-day or game-book link from the official game-centre page for one 2026 game, then check it resolves.

questions.q: What is the venue of each fixture, from the official game centre?
questions.held: Game-centre links follow nfl.com/games/<away>-at-<home>-2026-reg-<week>. No venue text captured.
questions.discover: Open each game-centre page and record the venue text with its URL and fetch time.

questions.q: Which definition of a multi-player rank-1 slot should be published?
questions.held: 160 slots with more than one player in the current depth file (empty slots excluded).
questions.missing: A written definition from the owner.
questions.discover: Owner states the definition; the count is recomputed from depth.json.

questions.q: Should the site split into a public analysis layer and a private data layer?
questions.held: A data-rights review file exists (audit/data-rights-review.md). Raw official rows are published now.
questions.missing: The terms of use, read and summarised.
questions.discover: Read the NFL terms and record a decision.

questions.q: How many timestamped reads are needed before an injury 'surprise' is published?
questions.held: One dated read. No clock times.
questions.missing: At least two reads with clock time.
